Q: Set image from one cell to image from another cell A:

This is taken directly from the first item on googling "excel VBA copy image from cell" (the VBA was streamlined a little)

Scenario 2: Modern Embedded Image (Inside the Cell)If your image was added via the newer "Place in Cell" formatting option, the image actually acts as the direct value of the cell. You can copy and paste the cell directly using normal clipboard operations

Sub CopyEmbeddedImage()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = ActiveSheet
    
    ws.Range("C3").Copy ws.Range("H5")
    
    Application.CutCopyMode = False
End Sub

Pretty straightforward
